battle.name: 魏燕之戰
battle.brief: 北魏神麚五年夏，太武帝拓跋燾遣平東將軍拓跋仁率騎兵五萬，由北平出塞、循盧龍塞山道入遼西，塞外擊潰北燕大將軍慕容評所率五萬眾，追奔至牛川，進逼龍城。和龍城牆高壕深，攻城須仰賴投石機、撞車、雲梯等器械壓制城頭，終以糧援不繼引還，北燕自此淪為魏之附庸。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 北魏與北燕兩個政權在遼西走廊正面接壤。北魏為拓跋什翼犍改建的代國，國號曰魏，定都平城（今山西大同），此時由太武帝拓跋燾在位，中書省與兵曹掌軍令，兵員以拓跋部騎兵與平城宿衛禁軍為骨干，遇大舉則徵發河北諸州丁騎隨軍。北燕為慕容皝建立的割據政權，都龍城（和龍，今遼寧朝陽），控有遼西、遼東與幽州東北部，國主慕容暐在位而實權握於大將軍、尚書令慕容評之手；北燕軍隊除慕容部本族與漢人郡兵外，還徵高句麗、宇文等部落的附庸兵眾充當前鋒與騎兵主力。龍城據塞外要衝而四野開闊，北燕倚之為根本與糧源，北魏則視此地為北方門戶。兩家的邊界由誰佔龍城、誰守盧龍塞來決定，誰進誰退全繫於此線。
countriesEn: Northern Wei and Northern Yan met face to face along the Liaoxi corridor. Northern Wei was the Dai state founded by Tuoba Shiyijian and renamed Wei, with its capital at Pingcheng (modern Datong, Shanxi); at this moment Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao was on the throne, the Zhongshu Sheng and the bing cao issued the military orders, and the troops were built around Tuoba clan cavalry and the Pingcheng palace guard, with riders and infantry levies from the Hebei prefectures attached to the field army on major campaigns. Northern Yan was the regime founded by Murong Huang, seated at Longcheng (Helong, modern Chaoyang, Liaoning), holding Liaoxi, Liaodong and the eastern part of Youzhou; the ruler Murong Hui sat on the throne while real power stayed in the hands of the General-in-Chief and Director of the Department of State Affairs, Murong Ping. Besides Murong clansmen and Han commandery troops, Northern Yan drew on the client levies of Goguryeo and the Yuwen tribes to serve as vanguard and cavalry. Longcheng guarded the strategic mouth of the pass and sat on open ground, so Northern Yan treated it as its base and its source of grain, while Northern Wei saw it as the northern gate of its own realm. Which side held Longcheng and which side held the Lukong pass decided the border, and who advanced and who retreated depended entirely on that line.
people: 北魏方面，太武帝拓跋燾在位第七年，北方諸部已大半歸附，親自統兵是他一貫作風，此次伐燕亦親率中軍直抵塞外。前鋒由平東將軍拓跋仁與征西將軍拓跋虔所部騎兵擔當，兩路合兵，專司突破與追擊；沿途設營，攻具與糧秣由隨軍輜重車隊負載，後勤幾乎全靠車營。北燕方面，國主慕容暐年事已高，臨事猶豫，決策常受制於人；大將軍慕容評掌軍政，執意出塞迎戰而不肯早退守城，兵敗退保龍城後仍主張死守，拒絕魏方招降。慕容奇（諸書或作慕容評之弟，或作其子）率二千餘騎再戰於牛川，全軍覆沒。禁軍大將慕容雲與慕容評同朝不睦，在戰役同時或其後不久弒慕容評，慕容暐遣慕容尚、慕容龕討之，慕容雲走保龍城而伏誅，北燕最後的主戰派由此自毀，拓跋燾則乘亂驅兵直抵城下。
peopleEn: On the Northern Wei side, Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao was in the seventh year of his reign; most of the northern tribes had already submitted, and leading in person was his habit, so he rode at the head of the central army into the country beyond the pass for this campaign as well. The advance was entrusted to the cavalry of the General of the Eastern Pacification, Tuoba Ren, and the General of the Western Conquest, Tuoba Qian, two columns that combined for the breach and for the pursuit. The army pitched camp on the march, and the siege engines and the grain were carried by the baggage train that followed, so the whole of the logistics rested on the wagon camps. On the Northern Yan side, the ruler Murong Hui was old and hesitant, and his decisions were largely made for him. The General-in-Chief Murong Ping held the military and civil authority, insisted on meeting the enemy in the open field instead of falling back behind the walls early, and after the defeat still demanded that Longcheng be held to the last rather than surrendered. Murong Qi, described in the sources variously as a brother or as a son of Murong Ping, led a little over two thousand cavalry into a second engagement at Niuchuan and was wiped out together with them. The Imperial Guard commander Murong Yun was already at odds with Murong Ping; at the same time as the campaign or shortly after it he killed Murong Ping, and Murong Hui sent Murong Shang and Murong Kan against him, so that Murong Yun fled to Longcheng and was put to death there. The Yan state thus destroyed its own last capable warlord, and Tuoba Tao drove straight to the walls on the strength of the confusion.
kits: 投石機在這場戰役中的位置屬攻城器械而非野戰兵器。龍城（和龍）城郭宏大，慕容皝營都時宮殿、宗廟、官署一仍魏晉之制，牆垣高厚、外繞深壕，北燕以弩弓、擂石與守城投石應敵。攻方要壓制城頭密集的弓弩手、損毀女牆與城樓，就必須帶上能把配重轉為投射動能的拋石機，即以絞盤或槓桿蓄力、甩出石彈與陶罐的投石機。漢代中國已有同源技術的發石車與霹靂車，三國時諸葛亮、曹操先後用於攻防，其形制雖與羅馬式 onager（驃獸拉桿砲）不同，原理同屬「把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭」。除投石機外，魏軍攻城器械還有撞車（撞竿）、雲梯與飛樓，各有分工：投石機拆牆、撞車破門、雲梯登城。野戰方面，北魏以輕騎配鐵鏃弓矢、札甲與槍刀，北燕以漢式強弩、蹶張弩及高句麗、宇文部騎兵對抗；守城一方還要倚賴鹿角、拒馬與壕溝阻滯騎兵衝鋒。
kitsEn: The onager's place in this campaign was among the siege engines rather than among the field arms. Longcheng (Helong) was a great city: when Murong Huang made it his capital he raised palaces, ancestral temples and offices on the Wei and Jin model, with high stone ramparts and a deep ditch outside them, and Northern Yan answered the attack with crossbows, bows, stones rolled down from the walls and its own stone-throwing engines. To silence the dense ranks of crossbowmen on the parapet, to break the parapet and the towers, the besiegers had to bring engines able to turn weight into projectile energy: the traction trebuchet, driven by a windlass or a lever, hurling stones and ceramic jars. China had possessed the same technology from the Han in the shape of the fashi che and the thunderbolt cart used by Zhuge Liang and Cao Cao in the Three Kingdoms period. The machine differed from the Roman onager in form, but the principle is identical, turning the stored effort of a windlass into a stone. Beside the onager, the Wei siege train included battering rams, scaling ladders and movable towers, each with its own task: the onager to smash the wall, the ram to break the gate, the ladders to climb. In the field, Northern Wei relied on light cavalry with iron-tipped arrows, lamellar armour, spears and sabres, while Northern Yan answered with the strong Han crossbow, the drawn crossbow and the cavalry of the Goguryeo and Yuwen contingents. The defenders also had to use antler barriers, cheval-de-frise and the ditch to slow the charge of horsemen.
tactics: 北魏的戰法是典型的塞外騎兵戰：先在北平一線集結，備馬備糧，再循慕容皝早年開鑿的盧龍塞山道東進，避開正面糾纏直取遼西空地；塞外遭遇戰中以縱火與密集騎鋒衝擊燕軍前陣，燕軍崩潰後不急於攻堅，長驅追奔至牛川，再擊潰慕容奇所率二千餘騎，隨後合兵進逼龍城。圍城階段，魏軍把投石機、撞車、雲梯列於城外，一面斷絕燕軍城外的田莊與鹽場，一面派使招降；因龍城守備完整、守軍拼死拒守，攻具未能奏效，加之後方糧道拉長、援軍遲滯，拓跋燾終究引還，只留將吏分守新取諸城。北燕的部署分三層：塞外前哨擋住魏軍主力，主力退保龍城，城內以巷戰與射火牽制攻城者。然而慕容評與慕容暐互相猜忌、慕容雲又起叛亂，令出一門難以做到，退與守的界線在城郊被拉成反覆拉鋸，最終演變成數年後第二次伐燕時的一舉崩潰。
tacticsEn: Northern Wei fought the classic way of the steppe: massing at Beiping first, with horses and grain in hand, then driving east along the mountain track that Murong Huang had cut through the Lukong pass, dodging a frontal entanglement and dropping into the open ground of Liaoxi. In the encounter beyond the pass the Wei horse used fire and a dense charge to break the Yan front, and when the Yan army collapsed the Wei did not rush the walls but drove the pursuit on to Niuchuan, broke Murong Qi's little over two thousand riders a second time, and then closed up on Longcheng with the combined columns. In the siege the Wei engines, the onager, the rams and the ladders, were deployed outside the walls, while the besiegers cut off the Yan fields and salt pans outside the city and sent envoys to demand surrender. Longcheng was held in full and its garrison fought to the last, the engines could not do their work, the rearward supply line grew longer and longer, reinforcements lagged, and Tuoba Tao finally withdrew, leaving officers and men behind to garrison the newly taken cities of You and Liaoxi. Northern Yan's deployment worked in three layers: an outpost beyond the pass to hold the Wei main force, the main body falling back on Longcheng, and the city itself, where street fighting and missile fire kept the besiegers pinned. Yet the mutual suspicion of Murong Ping and Murong Hui, and the revolt of Murong Yun, made a single command impossible; the boundary between retreat and stubborn defence was stretched into a see-saw before the walls, and the whole affair ended four years later when the second campaign against Yan broke at once.
data: 可核實的數字有限，且各書互有出入。魏軍出動兵力，〈魏書·太武帝紀〉與〈資治通鑑〉都記為騎兵五萬；北燕迎戰之眾記為五萬，慕容奇部為二千餘騎。塞外一戰斬首數千級，追奔至牛川再戰，慕容奇與其騎兵千餘人全沒，慕容評收散卒退保龍城。路徑方面，自平城集結至北平（幽州治，今北京）約數百里，再自北平出塞、循盧龍塞山道至龍城（和龍）約千里；盧龍塞山道綿延數百里，慕容皝開鑿之後即為北方往來的通道。戰役繫於神麚五年夏四月，〈魏書〉僅記「夏」，具體日數各書未詳。戰後第四年，太延二年（436）魏軍再出，龍城遂陷，北燕亡國。龍城營建時宮殿樓觀擬於魏晉，垣牆以石為築、壕濠寬深，可與史書所記城之堅固互相印證；魏軍遠來，糧秣自平城一路轉輸至塞外，是本戰最吃緊的一項消耗。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers are few, and the sources disagree with one another. Both the Wei Shu chronicle of Emperor Taiwu and the Zizhi Tongjian record the Wei force leaving the field as fifty thousand cavalry; the Yan host that came out to meet it is likewise recorded as fifty thousand, with Murong Qi's column a little over two thousand riders. The engagement beyond the pass cost the Yan several thousand dead, and the pursuit to Niuchuan destroyed Murong Qi together with his thousand-odd riders, after which Murong Ping gathered the survivors and fell back on Longcheng. As for the route: roughly several hundred li from the mustering point at Pingcheng to Beiping (the seat of Youzhou, modern Beijing), and then about a thousand li more from Beiping through the pass along the Lukong mountain track to Longcheng; the track itself runs for several hundred li and had been a standing highway of the north since Murong Huang opened it. The campaign is placed in the fourth month of summer in the fifth year of the Shenyan era, while the Wei Shu records only 'summer' and the exact days are nowhere given. Four years later, in the second year of the Taiyan era (436), the Wei army came out again and Longcheng fell, ending Northern Yan. The city had been laid out with palaces and towers on the Wei and Jin model, its ramparts built of stone and its ditch broad and deep, which fits the accounts of how solid the place was; and since the Wei army came from far away, the grain carried all the way from Pingcheng to the country beyond the pass was the most pressing consumption of the whole campaign.
cause: 北燕與北魏在遼西、幽州一線長期犬牙交錯，邊境既爭地盤又爭逃戶與鹽利。北燕內部，國主慕容暐與大將軍慕容評之爭已深，慕容評把持尚書令與兵權，慕容暐的若干決策須看其臉色；同時北燕曾出兵爭奪高陽、劉城方向，與北魏在冀、幽兩州衝突不斷。慕容皝開鑿的盧龍塞山道，一方面方便北燕控制塞內塞外的交通，另一方面也把北燕腹心暴露在北方騎兵的突擊距離之內。拓跋燾志在統一北方，平定赫連勃勃建立的夏與北涼餘部之後，遼西與龍城便成了最後一塊必須拿下的拼圖；北燕政權內部的裂痕又為他提供了不必硬攻便可能瓦解對手的機會。故此，出兵的理由在魏方是統一大業與邊境安寧，在燕方則是守土與爭生存空間，兩邊都把這場衝突視為不可再拖之事。
causeEn: Northern Yan and Northern Wei had long interlocked along the Liaoxi and Youzhou lines, disputing not only land but the people and the salt that came with it. Inside Northern Yan the struggle between the ruler Murong Hui and the General-in-Chief Murong Ping had gone deep: Murong Ping held the Department of State Affairs and the army, and several of Murong Hui's decisions had to wait on his mood; at the same time Northern Yan had sent troops to contest Gaoyang and Liucheng, and clashes with Wei in the prefectures of Ji and You never stopped. The mountain track that Murong Huang had cut through the Lukong pass gave Northern Yan control of the traffic inside and outside the pass, but it also exposed the heart of the Yan state to the striking distance of northern cavalry. Tuoba Tao's ambition was the unification of the north, and once the remnants of Helian Bobo's Xia and of Northern Liang had been settled, Liaoxi and Longcheng became the last piece he had to take, while the cracks inside the Yan state gave him a chance to break his opponent without smashing through the walls. The reason for the war was therefore, on the Wei side, the great work of unification and the quiet of the frontier, and on the Yan side the defence of the land and of room to live; both sides treated the clash as something that could no longer be put off.
impact: 這場戰爭沒有在當年滅掉北燕，卻改變了北方的權力版圖。北燕失掉幽州、遼西諸城與絕大多數人口土地，只剩龍城一隅；北魏得以在龍城置鎮屯兵，把防線從平城推到塞外，前線距離一下子縮短數百里。四年後太延二年（436）再伐，龍城陷落，北燕主慕容暐出奔、寄居高句麗方向，北燕亡國，遼西盡入北魏版圖，北方統一的最後一塊拼圖落定，拓跋燾與高句麗的邊界自此直接相接。內部而言，慕容雲弒慕容評、慕容評一系的諸將互相傾軋，使北燕在真正崩潰前十年已失去唯一能主持抗魏的強臣，敗亡的時間表由此提前。對北方民族格局而言，慕容部退出遼西、高句麗趁勢北拓，是草原勢力重新洗牌的開始；對攻城技術而言，這也是北方政權第一次大規模把投石機、撞車、雲梯這類器械隨騎兵部隊帶入遼西走廊，確立了「騎兵突進加上步卒攜械攻堅」的用兵模板，直到隋唐攻高句麗仍是同一套辦法。
impactEn: The campaign did not destroy Northern Yan in that year, but it redrew the balance of power in the north. Yan lost Youzhou, the cities of Liaoxi, and nearly all of its people and land, and was reduced to the single corner of Longcheng; Northern Wei was able to station troops and set up a depot at Longcheng, pushing the line forward from Pingcheng to beyond the pass and shortening the front by several hundred li in a single step. Four years later, in the second year of Taiyan (436), the army came out again, Longcheng fell, the Yan ruler Murong Hui fled in the direction of Goguryeo, Northern Yan ceased to exist, and all of Liaoxi was absorbed into Northern Wei; the last piece of the northern unification dropped into place, and the border between Tuoba Tao and Goguryeo now lay directly against the other. Internally, Murong Yun's killing of Murong Ping and the mutual suspicion among the commanders of Murong Ping's faction left Northern Yan without the one strongman who could have organised resistance to Wei, and so the timetable of its collapse moved forward by a decade. For the northern pattern of power, Murong withdrawal from Liaoxi and Goguryeo's northward expansion began a reshuffling of the steppe states. For the art of siege, it was also the first time a northern regime carried engines such as the onager, the ram and the scaling ladders deep into the Liaoxi corridor with a cavalry army, establishing the template of a cavalry advance supported by infantry-borne siege trains that was still in use when Sui and Tang struck at Goguryeo.
result: 塞外一戰，拓跋燾的騎兵擊潰慕容評的五萬眾，斬首數千，追奔至牛川再破慕容奇二千餘騎，北燕前鋒全滅，慕容評收散卒退保龍城。拓跋燾乘勝進兵龍城，攻具齊備而城不下：守軍閉門拒守，拓跋燾又不能久屯塞外，糧援不繼、士卒疲於道路，遂引軍而還，僅分留將吏鎮守新得的幽、遼西諸城。於是北燕沒有滅亡，卻已從割據一方的邊疆強國淪為向魏稱藩的附庸，慕容暐遣使請和、貢納方物，拓跋燾許之；北燕內部則因慕容雲弒評而元氣重傷，慕容評一系的將領再無一人能主持大局，四年後的最終崩潰中無人可支。這一戰的直接成果是拓跋燾打開了遼西通道並在龍城建立前哨，而真正兌現的成果要等到太延二年的第二次伐燕：龍城陷落，北燕亡國，遼西盡歸北魏，北方統一的大局由此奠定。
resultEn: In the field beyond the pass, Tuoba Tao's cavalry broke Murong Ping's fifty thousand, killing several thousand and pursuing to Niuchuan, where Murong Qi's two thousand-odd riders were destroyed a second time; the Yan vanguard was wiped out, and Murong Ping gathered the survivors and shut himself up in Longcheng. Tuoba Tao pressed on to the city with his engines deployed, but Longcheng did not fall: the garrison closed the gates and held, and the emperor could not keep an army in the field beyond the pass for long, for his supply line ran thin and his men were worn out by the road, so he withdrew and left officers behind to hold the newly taken cities of You and Liaoxi. Northern Yan was therefore not destroyed, but it had fallen from a powerful frontier state into a vassal of Wei that sent envoys to sue for peace and deliver tribute, and Tuoba Tao accepted. Internally the Yan state was badly shaken by the killing of Murong Ping, and not one of the commanders in that faction could take charge any longer, so when the final collapse came four years later there was nobody left to meet it. The direct result of this battle was that Tuoba Tao opened the road into Liaoxi and established an outpost at Longcheng; the result that actually cashed out came at the second campaign against Yan in the Taiyan era, when Longcheng fell, Northern Yan ended, all of Liaoxi passed to Northern Wei, and the unification of the north was thereby settled.
